title: Texting in French
tagline: mdr, tkt, jsp: abbreviations and the informal French of WhatsApp.
goal: Understand the most common texting abbreviations, recognise informal grammar (no ne, t'es, y a) and know when to use each register.

blocks.text: Like English («lol», «idk», «brb»), French shortens words in text messages. These are the ones you'll see every day:
Many use the **sound** of the letters in French: *c* = «say» = *c'est*, *g* = «zhay» = *j'ai*. Read them aloud and the word appears.
Texts copy **spoken** French, which simplifies several things:
In speech, almost every French person says *je sais pas* and *on*. It's normal among friends, but write the standard form in an email or an exam.

head: Friends and family
Work, official, strangers
rows: *Je vous prie de m'excuser pour ce retard.*

blocks.title: Careful with «bisous»
blocks.text: *Bisous* and *biz* are for friends and family. For colleagues, *Bonne journée* or *À bientôt*; for a formal email, *Cordialement* (Kind regards).

exercises.title: The right message
exercises.instructions: Choose the message that fits the situation.

items.prompt: You tell your boss you're running late.
options: Bonjour Madame Martin, je serai en retard de dix minutes. Bonne journée.
items.answer: Bonjour Madame Martin, je serai en retard de dix minutes. Bonne journée.

options: Cc ! Tu fais quoi ce soir ?
Madame, Monsieur, je me permets de vous écrire…
items.answer: Cc ! Tu fais quoi ce soir ?

items.prompt: You write to the university office.
options: Bonjour, je voudrais savoir si mon dossier est complet. Cordialement.
Slt, pk mon dossier il est pas arrivé ?
items.answer: Bonjour, je voudrais savoir si mon dossier est complet. Cordialement.

items.prompt: Dsl, chui en retard, j'arrive dans 5 min
options: Sorry, I'm late, I'll be there in 5 minutes.
Sorry, I'm not coming after all.
I'm here, waiting at the door.
items.answer: Sorry, I'm late, I'll be there in 5 minutes.

options: Don't worry, it's no big deal.
I don't know what's going on.
items.answer: Don't worry, it's no big deal.

items.prompt: On se voit auj ou demain ?
options: Shall we meet today or tomorrow?
Did we see each other yesterday?
Are you coming for dinner today?
items.answer: Shall we meet today or tomorrow?

items.prompt: Jsp pk il m'a pas répondu
options: Idk why he didn't answer me.
I know why he didn't answer me.
He doesn't know how to answer.
items.answer: Idk why he didn't answer me.

checklist: I understand *mdr, tkt, dsl, jsp, stp, bcp, rdv, pk*.
I recognise informal French: *je sais pas, t'es, y a, chui, on*.
I can turn an informal message into standard French.
I choose the register depending on who I'm writing to.

challenge.title: Your first chat
challenge.text: Write a short chat (six messages) between two friends making plans for the weekend, using at least five abbreviations. Then write the same conversation as a formal email to someone you don't know.
